metadata.description: Pavel Sokolov's Claude Code plugins — skills, rules and workflows.

plugins.name: hcb-dev
plugins.description: Personal developer baseline — a connected pipeline of skills: turning tasks or issues into sliced, reviewed work behind one planning gate; keeping deferred work in the forge's issue tracker, classified against what the repository actually defines; dependency versioning (with Dependabot sync); .gitignore seeding; local code review by two independent engines (Codex and Claude) consolidated into one coverage-checked report; completing work by mode (a local merge into the parent, or a change request (PR/MR), with the full review-and-merge drive on GitHub); handing work across sessions as a pasteable prompt in either direction; surveying a whole backlog slice against the code (tiers, the critical path, parallel lanes, what to take next); fanning an epic out in waves — a master session plans batches, launches them as chips into parallel sessions, coordinates over cross-session messaging with a durable wave ledger, and accepts each batch's return; and git cleanup of merged branches and stale worktrees.

plugins.name: markdown-docs
plugins.description: MCP server for efficient navigation of large markdown documents — datasheets, standards, manuals.

plugins.name: 1c-odata
plugins.description: MCP server for querying 1C:Enterprise databases over OData V3 — live schema introspection and read-only queries.
